messages:
maria (PM): FYI — Galeport Logistics asked for a private deployment commit for their Q2 pilot. They want SAML + KMS + 30k req/day throughput. asking for firm delivery date by EOD tomorrow.

jordan (AE): they signed the NDA and will pay for Dedicated minimum for 6 months. big upsell opportunity, but they need the KMS + audit logs for compliance.

liam (Eng Runtime): quick question — do they need GPT-style generation or embeddings only? that changes kernel/latency targets.

maria (PM): full chat generation (multi-turn) + embeddings for search. latency SLO: p95 < 450ms for prompt size median 512 tokens.

anya (Eng Platform): capacity note: 30k req/day with continuous batching maps to ~10 dedicated GPUs with steady-state batching assumptions. we can probably do 6-8 with aggressive batching but risk p95.

sophia (Security): KMS + audit logs are doable but they require HSM-backed keys (FIPS) and yearly key rotation policy. will need compliance paper trail — timeline add ~2w for approvals.

ken (Solutions Eng): they want data-plane isolation and IP allowlist. also asked for model pinning and rollback policy in case of quality regression.

maria (PM): ok — proposal draft: MVP for pilot = (1) private deploy with VPC + IP allowlist, (2) KMS integration (HSM if possible), (3) SAML SSO, (4) model pin + canary rollout, (5) basic cost/latency dashboard. target ship date: 2025-05-15.

jordan (AE): customer asked for 2025-04-30. can we re-evaluate scope to hit that earlier date?

liam (Eng Runtime): to hit 4/30 we should trim features: postpone HSM (use soft KMS + TODO to upgrade), postpone detailed cost dashboard (use barebones metrics), and limit model catalogue to 1 verified model. then dev effort looks like ~5w.

anya (Eng Platform): platform infra for private deploy + IP allowlist + SAML basic will take ~3w if we reuse the provisioner templates from Nimbus account. need capacity reservation: request 8 GPUs in Dedicated pool.

sophia (Security): soft KMS + compensating controls OK for pilot, provided we capture this in the SOC/contract appendix and schedule HSM upgrade in Q3.

maria (PM): decision point: Do we accept a trimmed MVP for 2025-04-30, with HSM and dashboard deferred to post-pilot? I need a clear yes/no so AE can close the commit.

ken (Solutions Eng): +1 for trimmed MVP; we should also include an uptime rollback SLA: if latency p95 > 700ms for two consecutive days, auto-failover to hosted model endpoint. adds some complexity but reduces customer risk.

liam (Eng Runtime): we have an auto-fallback path implemented — need to wire policy to the customer's route. estimate ~2d to enable and test.

anya (Eng Platform): I'll start a capacity request and template fork. owners: Anya (platform), Liam (runtime), Sophia (security), Ken (solutions), Maria (PM).

maria (PM): owner ack. I'll update the AE and legal with trimmed scope: target 2025-04-30 pilot go-live, deliverables listed above, HSM + full dashboard deferred to Q3, fallback policy enabled.

jordan (AE): I'll ask the customer to accept the trimmed SOW and confirm payment schedule.

maria (PM): Action items: 1) Anya open infra ticket + capacity request (due 2025-03-28), 2) Liam prototype fallback wiring (due 2025-04-07), 3) Sophia draft security appendix & temporary KMS controls (due 2025-04-04), 4) Ken prepare runbook + rollback playbook (due 2025-04-10), 5) Jordan get signed SOW (due 2025-03-29).

deploy-bot: deployment templates copied to workspace: `templates/private-deploy/galeport-2025`.

maria (PM): Thanks team. If any blocker surfaces, ping #eng-oncall and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
